content: We are spinning our own fates, good or evil, and never to be undone.
author: William James
story: James likened the human nervous system to a cosmic ledger where every moral compromise or act of integrity leaves an indelible trace on the brain's fibers. Addressing his students, he emphasized that character is not forged in rare moments of dramatic spectacle, but spun thread by thread across thousands of mundane, unnoticed choices made every afternoon.
reflectionPrompt: If your everyday choices today are the threads of your ultimate character, what kind of garment are you weaving?
